title: Jefferies再获新证据：问题产品发票造假
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: and talking about Jeffery's financial. The group has been told that some of the invoices underpinning its financing to an iron ore trader called Sapphire mini metals or min metals, excuse me,
segments.zh: 谈到杰富瑞的财务，该集团被告知，其为铁矿石交易商Sapphire Mini Metals或Min Metals提供融资所依据的部分发票不真实，据知情人士透露。

segments.en: are not genuine, this is according to people familiar with the matter. This has been a story that Bloomberg's been reporting out over the last week or so.
segments.zh: 这是彭博过去一周左右报道的事件。

segments.en: With more Bloomberg news, Chief Wall Street Correspondent, Sri Nader Rajan, covering the financial spaces here in studio, for those who maybe haven't been following,
segments.zh: 彭博新闻首席华尔街记者Sri Nader Rajan在演播室报道金融领域，对于那些可能没有关注的人，

segments.en: there's been a lot going on. What do we need to know?
segments.zh: 发生了很多事情。我们需要知道什么？

segments.en: This is the latest in a series of incidents, which is shining another light, shining more light on the risk around receivables finance.
segments.zh: 这是系列事件中的最新一起，进一步揭示了应收账款融资的风险。

segments.en: Typically, ordinarily, this should be safe. You are lending against invoices.
segments.zh: 通常，这应该是安全的。你是以发票为抵押进行贷款。

segments.en: It's secured by invoices. You expect your client to be ultimately paid and you expect to be paid back.
segments.zh: 它由发票担保。你期望客户最终付款，你期望得到偿还。

segments.en: When it goes right, it is good money for the lenders.
segments.zh: 当一切顺利时，这对贷方来说是笔好生意。

segments.en: But there are occasions when it can go wrong and it can go horribly wrong.
segments.zh: 但有时也会出错，而且可能错得离谱。

segments.en: And that sort of, we saw it last year with first brands and the collapse around first brands and all the allegations are on fraud and scam that came out.
segments.zh: 去年我们在First Brands身上看到了这种情况，围绕First Brands的承压以及所有欺诈和诈骗的指控。

segments.en: Now over the last week, we've seen these instances first with Radiant World, that Bloomberg reported last year.
segments.zh: 过去一周，我们看到了这些案例，先是去年彭博报道的Radiant World。

segments.en: And now another company, Sapphire Menmetal, which seems to be somewhat tied to Radiant World, at least at some point, Radiant World and its owners were majority owners of Sapphire Menmetal.
segments.zh: 现在又有一家公司，Sapphire Menmetal，似乎与Radiant World有关联，至少曾有一段时间，Radiant World及其所有者是Sapphire Menmetal的大股东。

segments.en: But the interesting bit for us is the connection of Point Bonita.
segments.zh: 但我们感兴趣的是Point Bonita的联系。

segments.en: Point Bonita is a trade finance fund. Trade finance focus fund.
segments.zh: Point Bonita是一家贸易融资基金，专注于贸易融资。
